versions.content: Service Name Dem_ClearPrestoredFreezeFrame Syntax Std_ReturnType Dem_ClearPrestoredFreezeFrame ( Dem_EventIdType EventId ) Service ID [hex] 0x07 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different EventIds. Non reentrant for the same EventId. Parameters (in) EventId Identification of an event by assigned EventId. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Clear prestored freeze frame was successful E_NOT_OK: Clear prestored freeze frame failed Description Clears a prestored freeze frame of a specific event. This API can only be used through the RTE and therefore no declaration is exported via Dem.h. API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemConfigSet/DemEvent Parameter.DemFFPrestorageSupported)} == true) Available via Dem.h
